views.name: nxt_title_matches
views.body_sql: SELECT m.id AS match_id, w1.name AS wrestler1_name, w2.name AS wrestler2_name, m.duration AS match_duration FROM Matches m JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id WHERE m.title_id IS NOT NULL AND m.title_change = 0
views.description: Denormalized match records joined with participant wrestler records to retrieve competitor names, restricted to title matches and excluding matches with title change indicators.

views.name: matches_ranked_by_duration
views.body_sql: SELECT match_id, wrestler1_name, wrestler2_name, match_duration, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY match_duration ASC) AS duration_rank FROM nxt_title_matches
views.description: Assigns a sequential rank to each valid match ordered by match duration in ascending order to identify the shortest match.
